# StatsCounter

> StatsCounter is a death counter and trophy/achievement counter for streamers, shown live on stream as an OBS widget (Browser Source). The web version is free; StatsCounter Desktop (Windows and Linux) updates the counter automatically by syncing with PSN, Steam and RetroAchievements. Available in Portuguese (pt-BR) and English.

## Web version (free)

- [StatsCounter](https://www.statscounter.pro/): create a death counter or trophy counter widget, copy its URL and add it to OBS as a Browser Source.
- Themes: Default, Basic (no borders/background), Basic 2 (no icons), Elden Ring, Dark Souls, Ninja Gaiden, God of War, Bloodborne, Ghost of Tsushima, Hollow Knight, Persona, Minecraft, Death Stranding 2.
- Recommended OBS size for trophies: 540x300 px with borders, 400x200 px without borders. For deaths: 250x300 px with borders, 300x200 px without borders.
- Counters are updated manually with buttons or keyboard hotkeys while the browser tab is open.

## StatsCounter Desktop (automatic)

- [StatsCounter Desktop (pt-BR)](https://www.statscounter.pro/desktop-app) · [English](https://www.statscounter.pro/en/desktop-app)
- Automatic trophy tracking: connect a PSN account (PS5 and PS4), Steam or RetroAchievements and the trophy/achievement counter updates on its own, even with the app minimized. No capture card or chat commands needed.
- Steam achievement banner: animated, fully customizable banner shown on stream whenever an achievement unlocks, for any game in the Steam library.
- Twitch and Kick chat bot: posts a message when the death or trophy counter goes up; viewers can type !deaths / !trophies (!mortes / !trofeus in Portuguese) to get the current count. Commands and messages are customizable.
- Global hotkeys that work with the game fullscreen and the app minimized, a timer between trophies, and full widget customization (fonts, colors, custom images or GIFs as icons, fraction/progress bar/percentage display).
- Access: lifetime license for supporters who contribute R$ 20 (Brazil, Mercado Pago) or US$ 20 (Buy Me a Coffee), including all future updates.
